# 修订后分析方案

## 摘要

基于用户指定的独立 AdventureWorks 只读数据源，沿用已经确认的业务定义，对需求指定的比较期与基期开展有效线上订单、区域收入变化、产品大类成交收入和客户复购分析。交付中文分析报告、区域收入变化柱状图，以及可用于复核的完整下载数据。

## 执行口径与步骤

- 严格使用指定的独立 AdventureWorks 数据源，不混入其他数据库的数据。
- 沿用已确认的有效状态和线上订单标记条件筛选有效线上订单。
- 订单数、订单收入和客单价按订单头粒度计算，避免明细连接后再汇总订单头金额。
- 订单收入使用订单头 `SubTotal`，不包含 `TaxAmt` 和 `Freight`。
- 比较期与基期按订单头 `OrderDate` 所属自然年度划分。
- 客单价使用对应期间有效线上订单的订单头 `SubTotal` 合计除以有效订单数。
- 金额使用 AdventureWorks 数据源金额单位；币种尚未确认，不称为人民币。
- 按比较期与基期分别输出有效线上订单数、收入、客单价及其变化，并保留地区维度的对应结果。
- 区域使用订单头 `TerritoryID`，通过区域维表补充名称；无法映射的记录归入“未知区域”，不直接丢弃。
- 区域收入变化定义为比较期区域收入减基期区域收入；区域贡献按区域变化额占总体收入变化额的比例表达。总体变化额不适用时避免计算贡献率，并明确标注；文字只使用“贡献”，不作因果解释。
- 产品大类成交收入按有效线上订单明细的 `LineTotal` 汇总，沿产品、子类和大类的已声明关联取得分类；无法映射到产品大类的记录归入“未分类”，并单独披露。
- 分别构建订单头汇总与订单明细汇总，避免订单头金额随明细展开而重复累计。
- 核对订单头主键与订单明细复合标识是否重复、有效订单的明细覆盖情况、订单明细金额与订单头小计的匹配情况，以及产品分类映射缺失情况；异常按实际结果披露，不从字段名称推断业务关系。
- 按自然年度和 `CustomerID` 汇总去重后的有效订单数；同年度内客户通过多张不同订单成交时识别为复购客户，复购率按复购客户数除以下单客户数计算，并比较比较期与基期的变化。
- 对复购率分母不适用、分类缺失、区域缺失及金额核对差异设置明确的展示规则，避免静默丢弃或使用无效分母。
- 报告中分别说明订单级指标和明细级指标的统计粒度，确保比较期与基期结果能够相互核对。

## 交付物与数据结构

- 中文报告包含核心结论、比较期与基期汇总、区域变化、产品大类变化、复购变化、数据质量核查和口径说明。
- 区域收入变化柱状图基于真实查询结果生成，覆盖“未知区域”并显示区域收入变化。
- 完整下载数据至少包括有效订单头、有效订单明细及产品分类映射、客户年度订单汇总与复购标识、区域汇总、大类汇总、头表与明细核对结果。
- 摘要及完整结果均保留来源字段和期间标识，金额明确标注未确认币种。

## 验证与验收

- 订单头汇总中的有效订单数和收入必须与订单头粒度结果匹配。
- 区域汇总的收入合计必须能够回接到总体订单头收入，未知区域单独列为可解释项。
- 产品大类汇总加上“未分类”后应覆盖有效订单明细收入，差异必须可解释。
- 头表与明细核对必须显式检查连接后是否产生订单头收入重复，并将相关异常列为核查结果。
- 客户年度订单汇总必须保证客户与期间的汇总粒度清晰，复购率分母保持有效。
- 图表使用真实分析结果，报告中的金额、变化额、客单价、贡献比例和复购率均须能追溯到查询或程序计算。
- 分析过程保持只读，不修改源数据库，不把区域或大类贡献表述为因果关系。

## 默认假设

- 采用已经确认的业务规则；方案不新增未获确认的金额成分或币种解释。
- 目标期间以用户需求指定的比较期与基期为边界，不扩展到其他年份。
- “完整数据”指与本次分析范围相关的订单头、订单明细、分类映射、客户复购和核对结果，不包含无关业务表。

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       COALESCE(t.Name, '未知区域') AS region_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.SalesOrderID) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.SubTotal) AS revenue,
       SUM(o.SubTotal) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.SalesOrderID) AS average_order_value
FROM salesorderheader o
LEFT JOIN salesterritory t
  ON o.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID
WHERE o.Status = 5
  AND o.OnlineOrderFlag = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate), COALESCE(t.Name, '未知区域')
ORDER BY region_name, order_year

# AdventureWorks 有效线上订单分析报告

## 口径与范围

分析仅使用指定的独立 AdventureWorks 只读数据源。比较期为 2003，基期为 2002。有效线上订单沿用已确认的 `Status` 与 `OnlineOrderFlag` 条件。订单数、订单收入和客单价均从订单头计算；订单收入使用 `SubTotal`，不包含 `TaxAmt` 和 `Freight`。客单价为订单头小计合计除以去重订单数。金额保留 AdventureWorks 数据源金额单位，币种尚未确认，不表述为人民币。区域与产品维度采用保留缺失记录的方式关联；下文采用修正后的映射审计结果。

## 核心结论

- 有效线上订单数由 2680 增至 10955，变化 8275，变化幅度 308.77%。
- 订单头收入由 6530858.55 增至 9805009.75，变化 3274151.2，变化幅度 50.13%。
- 客单价由 2436.89 变为 895.03，变化 -1541.86，变化幅度 -63.27%。订单数增加而客单价下降，结果按订单头口径计算。
- 区域收入正贡献以 Australia、United Kingdom、Germany、France、Southwest 和 Northwest 为主；Canada 的收入变化为负贡献。具体变化额及贡献比例见区域表。
- Bikes 是产品大类成交收入变化的主要正贡献项，Accessories 与 Clothing 也形成正贡献；未分类明细没有形成收入。产品大类仅以表格呈现。
- 复购比例由 0.0% 变为 13.29%。复购分母为该年度有有效线上订单的去重客户数。
- 订单头与明细年度总额分别对账后无差额。明细复合标识没有重复；但若先把订单头连接到明细、再按明细行累加订单头金额，会产生连接放大。

## 订单头总览

| 指标 | 基期 2002 | 比较期 2003 | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 有效线上订单数 | 2680 | 10955 | 8275（308.77%） |
| 订单头收入 | 6530858.55 | 9805009.75 | 3274151.2（50.13%） |
| 客单价 | 2436.89 | 895.03 | -1541.86（-63.27%） |

## 区域收入变化与贡献

| 区域 | 基期订单头收入 | 比较期订单头收入 | 收入变化 | 对总体收入变化的贡献 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Australia | 2154353.68 | 3041367.02 | 887013.33 | 27.09% |
| United Kingdom | 591586.85 | 1306168.3 | 714581.44 | 21.82% |
| Germany | 523412.41 | 1057435.6 | 534023.19 | 16.31% |
| France | 513545.31 | 1024692.39 | 511147.08 | 15.61% |
| Southwest | 1276567.45 | 1734502.44 | 457934.99 | 13.99% |
| Northwest | 848923.59 | 1095920.23 | 246996.65 | 7.54% |
| Northeast | 0.0 | 3966.81 | 3966.81 | 0.12% |
| Central | 0.0 | 2768.12 | 2768.12 | 0.08% |
| Southeast | 1565.98 | 2230.47 | 664.49 | 0.02% |
| Canada | 620903.28 | 535958.38 | -84944.9 | -2.59% |

区域结果中的“未知区域”已按保留缺失记录的方式处理；修正后的审计显示未知区域没有订单或收入。未舍入的区域收入合计回接订单头收入，未舍入回接差额分别为 6.612390279769897e-08 和 -1.0952353477478027e-06，属于浮点计算残差；表中的金额按显示精度舍入。

交互式区域对比柱状图“区域有效线上订单收入对比”已生成，展示各区域基期与比较期订单头收入，图表数据结果引用为 `916a5c7a85eadd24a8666a858c853c25`，图表引用为 `b5c9e23f8e92d8aa2a5f5500ad3a3163`。未生成其他图片。

## 产品大类成交收入

| 产品大类 | 基期明细收入 | 比较期明细收入 | 收入变化 | 对总体收入变化的贡献 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Bikes | 6530858.55 | 9371244.74 | 2840386.19 | 86.75% |
| Accessories | 0.0 | 294907.67 | 294907.67 | 9.01% |
| Clothing | 0.0 | 138857.34 | 138857.34 | 4.24% |
| 合计 | 6530858.55 | 9805009.75 | 3274151.2 | 100.0% |

Accessories 与 Clothing 在基期的有效线上订单明细中没有出现，比较期出现并形成正贡献；该描述只反映本次数据范围，不作需求变化原因判断。产品大类没有生成图表。

## 客户复购

| 指标 | 基期 2002 | 比较期 2003 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 有有效线上订单的去重客户数 | 2680 | 9335 |
| 复购客户数 | 0 | 1241 |
| 复购率 | 0.0% | 13.29% |

复购比例由 0.0% 变为 13.29%。复购客户按年度和客户归组，依据不同有效订单累计次数判定；分母采用各年度有有效线上订单的去重客户数。

## 对账与数据质量

| 核查项 | 基期 2002 | 比较期 2003 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 未知区域订单数 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| 未分类明细行数 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| 订单头行数 | 2680.0 | 10955.0 |
| 订单头去重标识数 | 2680.0 | 10955.0 |
| 订单头收入 | 6530858.55 | 9805009.75 |
| 明细行金额合计 | 6530858.55 | 9805009.75 |
| 年度头表明细对账差额 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| 明细行数 | 2680.0 | 24534.0 |
| 明细复合标识去重数 | 2680.0 | 24534.0 |
| 明细展开后的订单头金额累加 | 6530858.55 | 22091832.78 |
| 连接放大差额 | 0.0 | 12286823.03 |

# AdventureWorks 有效线上订单分析报告

## 口径与范围

分析仅使用指定的独立 AdventureWorks 只读数据源。比较期为 2003，基期为 2002。有效线上订单沿用已确认的 `Status` 与 `OnlineOrderFlag` 条件。订单数、订单收入和客单价均从订单头计算；订单收入使用 `SubTotal`，不包含 `TaxAmt` 和 `Freight`。客单价为订单头小计合计除以去重订单数。金额保留 AdventureWorks 数据源金额单位，币种尚未确认，不表述为人民币。区域与产品维度采用保留缺失记录的方式关联；下文采用修正后的映射审计结果。

SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS order_count,
       SUM(SubTotal) AS revenue,
       SUM(SubTotal) / COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS average_order_value
FROM salesorderheader
WHERE Status = 5
  AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
  AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
  AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate)
ORDER BY order_year

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       COALESCE(t.Name, '未知区域') AS region_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.SalesOrderID) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.SubTotal) AS revenue,
       SUM(o.SubTotal) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.SalesOrderID) AS average_order_value
FROM salesorderheader o
LEFT JOIN salesterritory t
  ON o.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID
WHERE o.Status = 5
  AND o.OnlineOrderFlag = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate), COALESCE(t.Name, '未知区域')
ORDER BY region_name, order_year

WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
)
SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       COALESCE(pc.Name, '未分类') AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS line_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.SalesOrderID) AS order_count,
       SUM(d.LineTotal) AS revenue
FROM valid_orders o
JOIN salesorderdetail d
  ON o.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
LEFT JOIN product p
  ON d.ProductID = p.ProductID
LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps
  ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN productcategory pc
  ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate), COALESCE(pc.Name, '未分类')
ORDER BY category_name, order_year

WITH valid_headers AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, SubTotal
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
),
line_by_order AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID,
         COUNT(*) AS line_count,
         SUM(LineTotal) AS line_revenue
  FROM salesorderdetail
  GROUP BY SalesOrderID
)
SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       COUNT(*) AS header_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.SalesOrderID) AS distinct_header_ids,
       SUM(h.SubTotal) AS header_revenue,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.line_revenue), 0) AS category_line_revenue,
       SUM(h.SubTotal) - COALESCE(SUM(d.line_revenue), 0) AS reconciliation_difference,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.SalesOrderID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS headers_without_detail,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.SalesOrderID IS NOT NULL AND ABS(h.SubTotal - d.line_revenue) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_with_amount_difference,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.SalesOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN d.line_count ELSE 0 END) AS detail_row_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.SalesOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(h.SalesOrderID, ':', d.SalesOrderID) END) AS comparable_headers
FROM valid_headers h
LEFT JOIN line_by_order d
  ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
ORDER BY order_year

WITH valid_headers AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, TerritoryID, SubTotal
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
),
region_audit AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         COUNT(*) AS unknown_region_orders,
         SUM(h.SubTotal) AS unknown_region_revenue
  FROM valid_headers h
  LEFT JOIN salesterritory t
    ON h.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID
  WHERE t.TerritoryID IS NULL
  GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
),
category_audit AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         COUNT(*) AS unclassified_lines,
         SUM(d.LineTotal) AS unclassified_revenue,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.ProductID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_product_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ps.ProductSubcategoryID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_subcategory_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.ProductCategoryID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_category_lines
  FROM valid_headers h
  JOIN salesorderdetail d
    ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON d.ProductID = p.ProductID
  LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
  LEFT JOIN productcategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
  GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.order_year, c.order_year) AS order_year,
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_orders, 0) AS unknown_region_orders,
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_revenue, 0) AS unknown_region_revenue,
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_lines, 0) AS unclassified_lines,
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_revenue, 0) AS unclassified_revenue,
       COALESCE(c.missing_product_lines, 0) AS missing_product_lines,
       COALESCE(c.missing_subcategory_lines, 0) AS missing_subcategory_lines,
       COALESCE(c.missing_category_lines, 0) AS missing_category_lines
FROM region_audit r
LEFT JOIN category_audit c
  ON r.order_year = c.order_year
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(r.order_year, c.order_year) AS order_year,
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_orders, 0),
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_revenue, 0),
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_lines, 0),
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_revenue, 0),
       COALESCE(c.missing_product_lines, 0),
       COALESCE(c.missing_subcategory_lines, 0),
       COALESCE(c.missing_category_lines, 0)
FROM category_audit c
LEFT JOIN region_audit r
  ON r.order_year = c.order_year
WHERE r.order_year IS NULL
ORDER BY order_year

WITH customer_year AS (
  SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year,
         CustomerID,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS order_count
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
  GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), CustomerID
)
SELECT order_year,
       COUNT(*) AS ordering_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
       SUM(order_count) AS distinct_orders_across_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS repeat_rate
FROM customer_year
GROUP BY order_year
ORDER BY order_year

WITH valid_headers AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, TerritoryID, SubTotal
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
),
years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year
  FROM valid_headers
),
region_audit AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         COUNT(*) AS unknown_region_orders,
         SUM(h.SubTotal) AS unknown_region_revenue
  FROM valid_headers h
  LEFT JOIN salesterritory t
    ON h.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID
  WHERE t.TerritoryID IS NULL
  GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
),
category_audit AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.ProductCategoryID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unclassified_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.ProductCategoryID IS NULL THEN d.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS unclassified_revenue,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.ProductID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_product_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ps.ProductSubcategoryID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_subcategory_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.ProductCategoryID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_category_lines
  FROM valid_headers h
  JOIN salesorderdetail d
    ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON d.ProductID = p.ProductID
  LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
  LEFT JOIN productcategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
  GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
)
SELECT y.order_year,
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_orders, 0) AS unknown_region_orders,
       COALESCE(r.unknown_region_revenue, 0) AS unknown_region_revenue,
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_lines, 0) AS unclassified_lines,
       COALESCE(c.unclassified_revenue, 0) AS unclassified_revenue,
       COALESCE(c.missing_product_lines, 0) AS missing_product_lines,
       COALESCE(c.missing_subcategory_lines, 0) AS missing_subcategory_lines,
       COALESCE(c.missing_category_lines, 0) AS missing_category_lines
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN region_audit r
  ON y.order_year = r.order_year
LEFT JOIN category_audit c
  ON y.order_year = c.order_year
ORDER BY y.order_year

WITH valid_headers AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, SubTotal
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
),
header_agg AS (
  SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS order_count,
         SUM(SubTotal) AS header_revenue
  FROM valid_headers
  GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate)
),
joined_agg AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         COUNT(d.SalesOrderDetailID) AS detail_row_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.SalesOrderID, ':', d.SalesOrderDetailID)) AS distinct_detail_keys,
         SUM(h.SubTotal) AS naive_header_sum_after_detail_join
  FROM valid_headers h
  JOIN salesorderdetail d
    ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
  GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate)
)
SELECT h.order_year,
       h.order_count,
       j.detail_row_count,
       j.distinct_detail_keys,
       h.header_revenue,
       j.naive_header_sum_after_detail_join,
       j.naive_header_sum_after_detail_join - h.header_revenue AS connection_inflation
FROM header_agg h
JOIN joined_agg j
  ON h.order_year = j.order_year
ORDER BY h.order_year

WITH valid_headers AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, SubTotal
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
),
line_by_order AS (
  SELECT SalesOrderID, SUM(LineTotal) AS line_revenue
  FROM salesorderdetail
  GROUP BY SalesOrderID
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS order_year,
         h.SalesOrderID,
         h.SubTotal,
         COALESCE(l.line_revenue, 0) AS line_revenue,
         h.SubTotal - COALESCE(l.line_revenue, 0) AS amount_difference
  FROM valid_headers h
  LEFT JOIN line_by_order l
    ON h.SalesOrderID = l.SalesOrderID
)
SELECT order_year,
       COUNT(*) AS comparable_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(amount_difference) > 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meaningful_amount_differences,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(amount_difference, 2) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cent_rounded_differences,
       MIN(amount_difference) AS minimum_difference,
       MAX(amount_difference) AS maximum_difference,
       SUM(amount_difference) AS net_difference,
       SUM(ABS(amount_difference)) AS absolute_difference_sum,
       MAX(ABS(amount_difference)) AS maximum_absolute_difference
FROM order_pairs
GROUP BY order_year
ORDER BY order_year

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       o.SalesOrderID,
       o.OrderDate,
       o.CustomerID,
       o.TerritoryID,
       COALESCE(t.Name, '未知区域') AS region_name,
       CASE WHEN t.TerritoryID IS NULL THEN '未匹配' ELSE '已匹配' END AS region_mapping_status,
       o.Status,
       o.OnlineOrderFlag,
       o.SubTotal,
       o.TaxAmt,
       o.Freight,
       o.TotalDue
FROM salesorderheader o
LEFT JOIN salesterritory t
  ON o.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID
WHERE o.Status = 5
  AND o.OnlineOrderFlag = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
ORDER BY o.OrderDate, o.SalesOrderID

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS order_year,
       o.SalesOrderID,
       d.SalesOrderDetailID,
       o.OrderDate,
       o.CustomerID,
       o.TerritoryID,
       d.ProductID,
       p.Name AS product_name,
       p.ProductSubcategoryID,
       ps.Name AS subcategory_name,
       ps.ProductCategoryID,
       pc.Name AS product_category_name,
       COALESCE(pc.Name, '未分类') AS category_display_name,
       CASE WHEN pc.ProductCategoryID IS NULL THEN '未匹配' ELSE '已匹配' END AS category_mapping_status,
       d.OrderQty,
       d.UnitPrice,
       d.UnitPriceDiscount,
       d.LineTotal
FROM salesorderheader o
JOIN salesorderdetail d
  ON o.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
LEFT JOIN product p
  ON d.ProductID = p.ProductID
LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps
  ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN productcategory pc
  ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
WHERE o.Status = 5
  AND o.OnlineOrderFlag = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
ORDER BY o.OrderDate, o.SalesOrderID, d.SalesOrderDetailID

WITH customer_year AS (
  SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year,
         CustomerID,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS order_count
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE Status = 5
    AND OnlineOrderFlag = 1
    AND OrderDate >= '2002-01-01'
    AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
  GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), CustomerID
)
SELECT order_year,
       CustomerID,
       order_count,
       CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_repeat_customer
FROM customer_year
ORDER BY order_year, CustomerID
